messages:
alex_support: HERA-prod customer reporting 403s after an API key rotation. Started ~09:12 UTC today. They rotated their key yesterday, now /v1/generate returns 403 invalid_api_key. Minimal repro below, any obvious propagation holes?

maria_infra: Do we know if they rotated via Vault KV or manually updated k8s secret? Also, are these calls coming from a single k8s deployment or multi-region? :eyes:

alex_support: They said rotation was via Vault (kv v2). App reads API key from env var set by k8s secret, but they also have a Vault Agent sidecar that templates a file to /etc/secrets/api_key. Calls originate from a single AWS cluster (eu-west-1) in a deployment named backend-hera.

chris_runtime: Can you paste the failing curl + response headers? Also check if any edge/proxy is returning 403 (so we know if it's auth at edge vs our auth service).

alex_support: Sure — here's the curl and response from the customer: 

```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer api_live_OLDKEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hello"}'

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "invalid_api_key",
  "hint": "key revoked"
}
```

maria_infra: That looks like our auth layer rejecting the token (not a proxy 502 or timeout). If Vault rotated the secret, we should confirm the pod saw the new value. Can someone get `kubectl exec` and cat the templated file and env?

hera_prod_engineer: I just checked a pod (backend-hera-7c9d4) and here's what we see: 

```
# env shows API_KEY env var set to NEWKEY
echo $API_KEY
api_live_NEWKEY
# file still contains the old key
cat /etc/secrets/api_key
api_live_OLDKEY
```

hera_prod_engineer: Our app prefers env var at startup, but the nodejs SDK we use falls back to reading /etc/secrets/api_key for long-running worker processes. We suspect the file never got updated after Vault rewrap.

chris_runtime: OK that's the smoking gun — two sources of truth (env at process start vs templated file). Vault Agent by default writes templates once unless configured to watch. If the sidecar didn't reload the template after KV version changed, the file will remain stale even though the env was updated by a rollout. Are they doing a rollout when rotating?

hera_prod_engineer: We rotated the Vault secret but we did not restart the deployment — we assumed Vault Agent would refresh the file in-place.

devops_jordan: Right — common pitfall. Solutions: set vault-agent template stanza with `change_mode = \"restart\"` or configure `reload_command` to SIGHUP the process. Alternatively, trigger a k8s rollout to refresh envs AND restart pods so the process picks up env-only config. For immediate mitigation, either patch the deployment (touch an env var) or restart the pods: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/backend-hera -n prod`. :thumbsup:

alex_support: For the support ticket, recommend the following runbook steps to the customer (short):
1) Verify Vault KV latest version contains the new key: `vault kv get -field=apikey secret/data/hera/keys`
2) Check the templated file in a pod: `kubectl exec <pod> -- cat /etc/secrets/api_key`
3) If file is stale, either restart pods or update vault-agent template to enable reload (example below)

Example vault-agent template stanza: 
```
template {
  destination = "/etc/secrets/api_key"
  contents = "{{ with secret \"secret/data/hera/keys\" }}{{ .Data.data.apikey }}{{ end }}"
  change_mode = "signal"
  change_signal = "SIGHUP"
}
```

devops_jordan: If they want zero-downtime, add a readiness check that only passes when the file matches the env (or have the app read only from a single source). Long-term we should recommend consolidating to one source of truth to avoid this class of bugs.

hera_prod_engineer: We did `kubectl rollout restart` and calls are passing with NEWKEY now. Confirmed with curl: `HTTP/1.1 200 OK` and payload returned. Thanks — will update the Vault Agent config and change our deploy docs.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout detected for deployment/backend-hera at 2026-03-17T09:25:12Z — 3/5 pods updated.

alex_support: Great. I'll add this to the support ticket notes: cause = mixed secret sources (env + templated file) + no pod restart after Vault rotation. Mitigation = restart pods or enable template reload; long-term = consolidate secret ingestion. Closing here unless the customer reopens. :white_check_mark:
